decisions.reason: As a newly launched next-generation core printing system that was prominently featured on the home page, it is likely a strategic flagship product with a normal industrial lifecycle still ahead of it.
This software module extends the firm’s variable-data printing offering and is a useful complement to the installed hardware base, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces fits the firm’s core industrial marking business and likely serves a durable niche, which argues for continued marketing.
A mobile decoding app is less central than the firm’s machinery and may be superseded, bundled into other software, or discontinued if uptake was limited.
Inline code verification is strategically important for quality assurance and complements coding equipment, making it likely to stay in the portfolio.
Print layout design software supports the usability of the firm’s marking systems and was important enough to appear on the home page, so it should remain on the market.
